definitions: A measure used in routers to select the best path when there are multiple paths to the same destination from different routing protocols. It is a value from 0 to 255, where lower values indicate higher trustworthiness.
A metric used by Cisco routers to rank the trustworthiness of routing information sources.
examples: The router chose the OSPF route because it had a lower administrative distance.
You can manually configure the administrative distance for static routes.
EIGRP has a default administrative distance of 90.
